trivia.q: To whom is the third letter of John addressed?
trivia.info: John addresses this short letter to his beloved Gaius.

trivia.q: Which church leader loved to have the preeminence and refused to receive the brethren?
trivia.info: Diotrephes loved to have the preeminence among them.

trivia.q: Which man was well reported of by all men, and by the truth itself?
trivia.info: Demetrius had a good report from everyone, and from the truth itself.
